## Purpose

What problem does this change solve?

## Layer

- [ ] Stable / operational
- [ ] Experimental
- [ ] Art / canon
- [ ] Documentation / governance

## Evidence boundary

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated

## Recovery
